newsitem.title: UK: Granada will not demerge media businesses.
newsitem.headline: Granada will not demerge media businesses.

text.p: British leisure and television group Granada Group Plc said on Wednesday it had no current plans to demerge its media businesses.
"The fact is we see no reason at all why that (demerger) is likely to happen in the short term," Granada chairman Gerry Robinson told a news conference.
Robinson said there may be some point in the future when the media interests could be split off but stressed that that point had not yet been reached.
